question: What purificatory substance should the foremost mantra-knower give the bathed disciple?
premises: The foremost knower of mantras administers a substance.
The substance is the five products of the cow.
inference: The foremost mantra-knower should make the bathed disciple drink the five cow-products.
plain_english: The foremost knower of mantras should make the bathed disciple drink the five products of the cow.
